10398823321.title: Taking a sabbatical as a business owner

fields.message[content]:
Hi!

My name is Matthias, I am 27 years old and currently working at an advertising agency in Stockholm, Sweden. I am a big fan of your podcast and just wanted to tell you that you are doing a great job. Your podcast is pure gold!

Take care and thanks for doing the podcast!

Best,
Matthias.
Episode 61 did really well, far surpassing Episode 60. REWORK continues to grow!

fields.document[content]:
Welcome to this special bonus episode of REWORK, a podcast about a better way to work and run your business. REWORK be back next week with another regular episode. For today's special edition, I interviewed the founders of 37signals to dig deeper into remote work.

Thanks for listening to REWORK. We’ll be back next week with another regular episode! We’d love to hear what you think of the show. You can find show notes and transcripts at https://37signals.com/podcast/. And as always REWORK is brought to you by 37signals, makers of Basecamp and HEY.

fields.message[content]:
Hi ! I’m going to be in New York two weeks from now for a family vacation (Nickolas’s brother is graduating and my in-laws will also be in town). On a whim, I cold emailed Jonathan Grado at Grado Labs, a family-owned company in Brooklyn that manufactures high-end headphones and phonograph cartridges. They’ve been around since 1953.

He emailed back right away and was interested in being featured on REWORK! Right now I’m scheduled to visit their factory and do the interviews on that Thursday.(The time is TBD.)

Are you interested in coming out to New York? I know it’s a big production for you to fly out to New York for a day of work, but if you had another reason to be there or just felt like a New York trip, it could be fun to do this one together like usual! If you can’t make it, I’ll find a New York-based freelancer (although of course it won’t be the same).
